svg.title: PROJECTS still brewing in my garage..
svg.desc: The pale pixel ghost from the Resident stands beside a square iron cauldron that brews green potion over a small fire in a haunted Minecraft garage. Pixel bubbles rise and pop. Three potion bottles, a brewing stand, cobweb, pumpkin and dark doorway surround the still sign. The brewer floats and blinks, a spoon stirs, steam curls upward, bubbles rise and pop, and embers lift from the fire. The sign and architecture stay still.
